messages:
ajay: Started the nccl 2.21 rollout to eu-west2 ~10:00 UTC. within minutes a few 8xA100 pods started showing stuck collectives (allreduce/allgather). hitting production inference jobs. :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: deploy nccl/2.21 -> eu-west2 completed for nodepool-gpu-8 at 10:03 UTC

ajay: symptoms: worker processes spinning, token throughput drops to zero, client requests time out after 30s. stack traces show threads blocked in ncclRecv/Send and epoll_wait. quick dump below:

```
#0  0x7f8b9c2b8d3a in ncclTransportReduceRecvCopy ()
#1  0x7f8b9c2c0a4f in ncclAllReduceKernel ()
#2  0x55a1f9d3b6f0 in start_worker_loop (/srv/inference/bin/worker)
#...
```

ajay: repro seems to require: (1) >=8 GPUs, (2) RDMA active, (3) >1024 token sequences concurrently. single-node 4x tests fine.

maria: is this only eu-west2? any reports in us-west2/ap-south?

ajay: only eu-west2 so far (that's where we rolled first). stamping logs from one node:

```
[2026-03-18T10:06:12Z] nccl WARN: transport timed out, retrying
[2026-03-18T10:06:12Z] nvlink: link error - peer reset
[2026-03-18T10:06:13Z] worker[pid=2345] stuck in epoll_wait
```

keegan: can you capture pstack and /proc/net/dev counters? also run `ibstatus` and `ibv_devinfo` on the hosts. might be a driver/kernel interaction with the new nccl.

ajay: collecting now. running `sudo gdb -p 2345 -batch -ex "thread apply all bt"` and `sudo perf top -p 2345` then uploading to /tmp/nccl-dumps.

olivia: quick mitigation option: we can revert the nccl package to 2.20.3 on affected nodepool via canary rollback. that avoids touching drivers. will still need a coordinated patch for RDMA path.

hannah: cost note: rollback will trigger some capacity churn and ~6% CPU overhead while rebalancing. fine if it restores latency.

ajay: dump uploaded: /tmp/nccl-dumps/eu-west2-node-03/1784500000.tgz — contains bt, ibv_devinfo, dmesg. interesting dmesg lines show repeated "mlx5: HCA port down" around the hangs.

maria: could be firmware+nccl combination. any recent mlx5 firmware bumps in that region?

keegan: not on our side; host AMIs unchanged. but we did roll CUDA driver 13.2 two weeks ago for other perf patches. possible three-way interaction: CUDA driver + mlx5 fw + nccl 2.21 RDMA path.

ajay: quick test: disabled RDMA on one failing host (set NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1, NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0). after restarting worker, collectives proceed but latency is worse — throughput restored. so RDMA path seems implicated.

olivia: good triage. plan: (A) pause the rollout, (B) revert eu-west2 nodepool to nccl 2.20.3, (C) open ticket with vendor (NVIDIA/mellanox) with logs/firmware+driver matrix.

sre-bot: alert created: #INC-2026-4799 "eu-west2 nccl collectives hang" severity=P2, alert link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-4799

ajay: agreed. starting rollback on nodepool-gpu-8 now. invoking playbook:

```
/opt/redwood/playbooks/rollbacks/revert-nccl.sh --region eu-west2 --version 2.20.3 --nodes nodepool-gpu-8
```

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: job_id=rb-20260318-447, started 10:22 UTC

maria: after rollback, let's run 4h canary with stress harness (8x v100 emulation) and a mix of short/long sequences. need to ensure no regressions on image-serving tails.

keegan: I'll prepare a repro harness that toggles NCCL_IB_DISABLE and injects network latencies. if vendor patch arrives we can test against 2.21+patched mlx5.

olivia: documenting immediate remediation in the runbook and tagging customers who hit 504s. will also add a dashboard panel for nccl transport retries and mlx5 link events.

hannah: please call out if rollback fails or if rebalancing causes pod evictions beyond 5% — we may need additional capacity.

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-20260318-447 completed successfully at 10:42 UTC; affected nodes back on nccl 2.20.3.

ajay: nodes back to stable, canary load looks clean so far. keeping the thread open for vendor follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:
